card.name: Conditional words in patient-selection phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as if, the, on, be, in right after 'only', 'unless', 'based' or 'select patients for treatment', where a condition for using a drug is being set up.

modes.label: Only if / unless clauses
modes.description: The word 'if', 'when' or 'the' after 'only' or 'unless' introduces a benefit-versus-risk condition.
modes.example: Use nintedanib capsules in patients with known risk of bleeding only<< if>> the anticipated benefit outweighs the potential risk

modes.label: Selecting patients based on a marker
modes.description: 'on' or 'the' after 'based' in instructions to select patients by a gene or marker.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Select patients for treatment with GAVRETO based<< on>> the presence of a RET gene fusion.
